asA: beta reader trusting the referee-guarantees page's verified-invariant promise
iWant: `rcf define update` to refuse writing FBS.executionStatus=verified by default, and `rcf build finalise` to refuse promotion when the git working tree is not on a default trunk
soThat: a chain that says verified traces to an actual post-merge runtime check by construction, and a mid-branch dev-loop finalise cannot stamp verified without the operator's deliberate opt-out
title: US-16502: finalise is the only path to verified, and it fires only on a default trunk

acceptanceCriteria.description: The writer refuses a define-update patch that sets FBS.executionStatus=verified when `options.allowVerifiedOverride` is not true. The refusal is an RcfError with kind='usage' whose message names the finalise gate and the --acknowledge-verified-override escape flag; the FBS on disk stays unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an FBS at status 'complete' loaded through walkTree
acceptanceCriteria.when: updateDocument is called with sets = [{path:'executionStatus', value:'verified'}] and options = {}
acceptanceCriteria.then: the result is an RcfError with kind='usage' matching /verified is written only by the finalise gate/, and the FBS file on disk still reads status 'complete'

acceptanceCriteria.description: Passing `options.allowVerifiedOverride: true` (the seam that finalise and `rcf define update --acknowledge-verified-override` both use) writes the value: the returned shape carries the doc id and the FBS on disk reads status 'verified'.
acceptanceCriteria.when: updateDocument is called with the same sets and options = {allowVerifiedOverride: true}
acceptanceCriteria.then: the result carries an id and the FBS file on disk reads status 'verified'

acceptanceCriteria.description: `rcf build finalise` promotes on any branch (claim C-26 reversed by the operator ruling of 2026-10-21, ADR-4151): on a git working tree on a branch other than main or master whose HEAD contains the report head it promotes with no flag, refusing nothing for the branch and printing no claim C-26 line; --allow-pre-merge changes nothing (it is accepted with one deprecation line, AC-19005-9).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project whose git working tree is on branch topic-x, HEAD containing the head of a committed valid verifier report with verdict PASS and ship authority, and the FBS at complete with a Code Node on every bound AC
acceptanceCriteria.when: `rcf build finalise <fbsId> --ci-run <ref>` is invoked, and on a second identical project with --allow-pre-merge appended
acceptanceCriteria.then: both runs exit 0 with executionStatus verified; neither stderr matches /git working tree is on branch/ and neither stdout matches /Referee-guarantees claim C-26 records the pre-merge decision here/
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: Finalise still runs on any branch before the merge, but it promotes to complete from verdicts, not to verified from a report (ADR ADR-4157).
